name: OpenTrack
summary: Open-source head tracking software. Routes tracking data from any tracker (webcam, IR, Wiimote, joystick, etc.) to games via various output protocols.
notes: OpenTrack itself does not produce 3D output — it provides head tracking data to games or to other tools like VRto3D. Required as a prerequisite for Leia Track App on SR displays.
install_notes: No automated install. Download from GitHub releases and run the installer. No game folder integration needed.
